Il Raptor Vacuum ha un ugello più ampio,: Raptor Vacuum has a larger nozzle that allows exhaust gases to expand in space.
Il primo razzo orbitale con un primo sta: The first orbital rocket with a reusable first stage.
Falcon 9 porta satelliti e capsule Drago: Falcon 9 carries satellites and Dragon spacecraft into orbit. The first stage powers the initial ascent and can land to fly again. The second stage delivers the payload to its intended orbit.
Il diametro di 3,7 metri si riferisce al: The rocket body is 3.7 metres wide. The protective fairing around the satellites is wider.
Nove Merlin alimentati a ossigeno liquid: Nine Merlin engines burning liquid oxygen and RP-1 kerosene lift the rocket off the pad. Four landing legs deploy just before touchdown.
Questa struttura collega i due stadi fin: The interstage connects the two stages until separation. Four grid fins then guide the returning first stage towards its landing zone.
Un singolo Merlin Vacuum può riaccenders: A single Merlin Vacuum engine can restart during flight to deliver payloads to different orbits.
Una carenatura in materiale composito pr: A composite fairing shields satellites during atmospheric ascent. On Dragon missions, the capsule takes its place.
I nove motori del primo stadio sono prog: The nine first-stage engines are designed to operate in the atmosphere and to fly again after recovery.
Il secondo stadio usa una versione del M: The second stage uses a version of Merlin with a larger nozzle, optimised for operation in space.
Con Dragon, Falcon 9 trasporta equipaggi: Falcon 9 launches Dragon spacecraft carrying crews or supplies to the International Space Station.
Nelle missioni condivise più clienti pos: On rideshare missions, satellites from multiple customers travel to orbit on the same launch.
New Glenn porta satelliti e altri carich: New Glenn carries satellites and other payloads into orbit. Its first stage is designed for recovery and reuse.
Sette motori BE-4 alimentano il primo st: Seven BE-4 engines power the first stage. Two hydrogen-fuelled BE-3U engines propel the second stage and its payload towards their destination.
New Shepard trasporta persone ed esperim: New Shepard carries people and experiments above 100 kilometres. The capsule separates from the booster, giving its occupants several minutes of microgravity.
La capsula pressurizzata torna a terra c: The pressurised capsule returns under parachutes. The booster restarts its BE-3PM engine to land vertically.
Un sistema di trasporto per l’orbita ter: A transportation system for Earth orbit, the Moon and Mars.
Starship è il nome della nave e dell’int: Starship is the name of both the spacecraft and the complete launch system. SpaceX is designing both stages for recovery and reuse. The figures refer to the configuration in the official vehicle guide.
La nave Starship viaggia sopra il booste: The Starship spacecraft sits atop the Super Heavy booster. Together they stand 124 metres tall.
Dopo la separazione, la nave continua ve: After separation, the spacecraft continues towards orbit. It is designed to carry cargo and, in the future, crews.
Il booster sostiene il veicolo durante l: The booster powers the initial ascent. On its return, the launch tower’s arms are designed to catch it.
I Raptor di Starship e Super Heavy utili: Starship and Super Heavy use Raptor engines burning liquid methane and liquid oxygen. In this configuration, the spacecraft has three sea-level engines and three vacuum engines.
Per le missioni lunari SpaceX prevede il: For lunar missions, SpaceX plans to transfer propellant between vehicles in Earth orbit before departure.
Il trasporto di materiali sulla superfic: Delivering cargo to the Martian surface is one of the programme’s goals. It requires long-duration flight and the ability to land with the payload.
A Starbase, in Texas, SpaceX costruisce,: SpaceX builds, tests and launches Starship at Starbase in Texas. The towers stack the stages on the pad and are designed to catch returning vehicles.
